explanation: On S₁, v=0 and u increases from 0 to 1. Thus x=u and y=u²=x², an upward-opening parabola traversed from (0,0) to (1,1).

answers.correct_value: An arc of an upward-opening parabola, traversed from $(0,0)$ to $(1,1).$
answers.wrong_value: An arc of an upward-opening parabola, traversed from $(1,1)$ to $(0,0).$
